request.style: English, warm male vocal, solo with subtle choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, strings, gentle, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A song of ascents from Solomon
Unless the Lord builds the house
Its builders labor in vain
Unless the Lord watches over the city
The watchman keeps guard in vain

[Chorus]
The Lord builds the house
The Lord watches over the city
Our labor is vain without Him
He gives us the victory

[Verse]
In vain you rise early
And stay up late to toil
Eating the bread of anxious work
Trying to fulfill your goal
But the Lord gives sleep
To the one he loves
Resting in His sovereign grace
Away from the waves

[Chorus]
The Lord builds the house
The Lord watches over the city
Our labor is vain without Him
He gives us the victory

[Bridge]
Look, children are a heritage
From the Lord himself
The fruit of the womb is a reward
A blessing in life
Like arrows in the hand
Of a warrior strong
So are the sons of one's youth
Where they belong

[Outro]
The Lord builds the house
The Lord watches over the city
Amen
